_readme: Details for the cards whose art lives in public/cards. Keys are card ids (file name without its _X suffix, lower-case, dashes). Every field is optional: name, kind (beast | character), domain, symbol, flavor, power, rarity.

death.name: Death
death.flavor: Every sequence converges here. Only one in a hundred thousand ever meets it.

scaly-emperor.name: Draconis, the Scaly Emperor
scaly-emperor.flavor: Lost the palace, kept the crown. Every scale on his hide is a prime; he has counted.

clockwork.name: Clockwork, the Bound Automaton
clockwork.flavor: Chained inside the broken hour. It counts every tick, because nobody else will.

lydia.name: Lydia, the Star Cartographer
lydia.flavor: Maps the sky one angle at a time, and keeps her friends in the margins.

godlike-ganesh.name: Godlike Ganesh
godlike-ganesh.flavor: Removes obstacles. Divides by zero when nobody is looking.

carax-the-destroyer.name: Carax the Destroyer
carax-the-destroyer.flavor: Leaves nothing standing but the primes.

tiamat.name: Tiamat
tiamat.flavor: Five heads, five answers, all of them correct.

samurai-tanuki.name: Samurai Tanuki
samurai-tanuki.flavor: Never draws the blade before checking the proof.

brutal-basilisk.name: Brutal Basilisk
brutal-basilisk.flavor: One look and the unknown freezes in place.

giant-squid.name: Giant Squid
giant-squid.flavor: Ten arms, ten integrals, no daylight.

prehistoric-megalodon.name: Prehistoric Megalodon
prehistoric-megalodon.flavor: Older than counting, larger than the sum.

reborn-phoenix.name: Reborn Phoenix
reborn-phoenix.flavor: Every ending is the first term of the next series.

the-last-griffin.name: The Last Griffin
the-last-griffin.flavor: Circles the peak in a perfect golden spiral.

lion-jungle-king.name: Lion, Jungle King
lion-jungle-king.flavor: Rules by the one rule that has no exceptions.

alpha-wolf.name: Alpha Wolf
alpha-wolf.flavor: The pack follows the first element.

bengal-tiger.name: Bengal Tiger
bengal-tiger.flavor: Its stripes never meet. Parallel to the end.

elegant-eagle.name: Elegant Eagle
elegant-eagle.flavor: Sees the angle from a mile above it.

hammerhead-leader.name: Hammerhead Leader
hammerhead-leader.flavor: Its head is a bar chart and every bar is bad news.

ricky-the-rat.name: Ricky the Rat
ricky-the-rat.flavor: Solved the maze, then sold the map.

siberian-tiger.name: Siberian Tiger
siberian-tiger.flavor: Each winter is the sum of the two before.

amazon-anaconda.name: Amazon Anaconda
amazon-anaconda.flavor: Ties the knot no one can classify.

artic-caribou.name: Arctic Caribou
artic-caribou.flavor: Migrates the same distance every year, to the metre.

artic-fox.name: Arctic Fox
artic-fox.flavor: Hears a number move under the snow.

black-panther.name: Black Panther
black-panther.flavor: You never see it coming. That is the unknown.

black-widow.name: Black Widow
black-widow.flavor: Her web is a perfect polar grid.

blue-whale.name: Blue Whale
blue-whale.flavor: The largest number that ever sang.

cruel-crocodile.name: Cruel Crocodile
cruel-crocodile.flavor: Its jaw is the greater-than sign. Always was.

electric-eel.name: Electric Eel
electric-eel.flavor: Six hundred volts and one very sharp curve.

gorilla-family.name: Gorilla Family
gorilla-family.flavor: Count them twice; one of them is hiding.

histeric-hippo.name: Hysterical Hippo
histeric-hippo.flavor: Laughs at the odds, then sits on them.

majestuous-peacock.name: Majestic Peacock
majestuous-peacock.flavor: Never shows the same arrangement of feathers twice.

menacing-cheetah.name: Menacing Cheetah
menacing-cheetah.flavor: The derivative of a cheetah is still a cheetah.

secret-sea-horse.name: Secret Sea Horse
secret-sea-horse.flavor: Its tail is a Fibonacci spiral, and it knows.

hysterical-hyena.name: Hysterical Hyena
hysterical-hyena.flavor: Laughs at every wrong answer. Laughs a lot.

ant-eater.name: Ant Eater
ant-eater.flavor: Thirty thousand a day. It keeps a tally.

artic-seal.name: Arctic Seal
artic-seal.flavor: Balances the ball at the exact centre of mass.

beautiful-butterfly.name: Beautiful Butterfly
beautiful-butterfly.flavor: Perfect symmetry, one line down the middle.

chameleon-kun.name: Chameleon-kun
chameleon-kun.flavor: Its colour is a random variable with excellent taste.

chinese-panda.name: Chinese Panda
chinese-panda.flavor: Eats bamboo in units of one hundred percent.

dolphin-daphne.name: Dolphin Daphne
dolphin-daphne.flavor: Jumps in a parabola. Lands in a smile.

juliette-lemur.name: Juliette Lemur
juliette-lemur.flavor: Leaps from branch to branch in a strict progression.

neat-narwhal.name: Neat Narwhal
neat-narwhal.flavor: Its horn is the axis; everything else is rotation.

orange-orangutan.name: Orange Orangutan
orange-orangutan.flavor: Thinks for a long time, then is right.

otto-and-olga-otters.name: Otto and Olga Otters
otto-and-olga-otters.flavor: Two otters, one pebble, four ways to hold hands.

pirry-platypus.name: Pirry Platypus
pirry-platypus.flavor: Refutes every classification it is given.

rickety-rino.name: Rickety Rhino
rickety-rino.flavor: Charges in a straight line. Stops at the sum.

savanah-zebra.name: Savannah Zebra
savanah-zebra.flavor: Black or white. No third option.

tasmanian-devil.name: Tasmanian Devil
tasmanian-devil.flavor: Spins so fast the limit never settles.

whale-shark.name: Whale Shark
whale-shark.flavor: Filters the ocean one decimal at a time.

wolf-pack.name: Wolf Pack
wolf-pack.flavor: Six wolves, seven hundred and twenty orders to howl in.

elegant-flamingo.name: Elegant Flamingo
elegant-flamingo.flavor: One leg. Perfect balance. Zero wobble.

armand-armadillo.name: Armand Armadillo
armand-armadillo.flavor: Rolls into a sphere when the question gets hard.

axel-axolotl.name: Axel Axolotl
axel-axolotl.flavor: Regrows a limb for every proof it loses.

blessed-bat.name: Blessed Bat
blessed-bat.flavor: Sees the answer with its ears.

bouncy-kangaroo.name: Bouncy Kangaroo
bouncy-kangaroo.flavor: Every hop is the same length. It checked.

cheeky-chimpanze.name: Cheeky Chimpanzee
cheeky-chimpanze.flavor: Knows the answer. Waits to see if you do.

clingy-koala.name: Clingy Koala
clingy-koala.flavor: Holds on to the answer for twenty hours a day.

clucking-chicken.name: Clucking Chicken
clucking-chicken.flavor: Counts its eggs before they hatch. Always right.

crusing-clownfish.name: Cruising Clownfish
crusing-clownfish.flavor: Finds home in a sea of possibilities.

cute-cow.name: Cute Cow
cute-cow.flavor: Four stomachs, four times the digestion.

desert-camel.name: Desert Camel
desert-camel.flavor: Stores water for the long series ahead.

forest-deer.name: Forest Deer
forest-deer.flavor: Its antlers branch like a tree diagram.

freaky-froggo.name: Freaky Froggo
freaky-froggo.flavor: Jumps lily pads two at a time.

free-falcon.name: Free Falcon
free-falcon.flavor: Dives at the steepest slope it can find.

giggly-goat.name: Giggly Goat
giggly-goat.flavor: Eats the exam, then passes it.

happy-ferret.name: Happy Ferret
happy-ferret.flavor: Finds the missing number under the sofa.

henry-the-hedgehog.name: Henry the Hedgehog
henry-the-hedgehog.flavor: Every quill is a prime. Do not test it.

humble-ant.name: Humble Ant
humble-ant.flavor: One of ten thousand, and proud of the sum.

kawaii-kitty.name: Kawaii Kitty
kawaii-kitty.flavor: Knocks the wrong answer off the table.

oceanic-octopus.name: Oceanic Octopus
oceanic-octopus.flavor: Eight arms, eight answers, one of them right.

plain-pigeon.name: Plain Pigeon
plain-pigeon.flavor: Ten pigeons, nine holes. You know the rest.

pleased-piggy.name: Pleased Piggy
pleased-piggy.flavor: Rolls in the mud; the mud is a distribution.

polen-bee.name: Pollen Bee
polen-bee.flavor: Builds hexagons because the maths said so.

savanah-buffalo.name: Savannah Buffalo
savanah-buffalo.flavor: A thousand of them and one total.

savanah-ostrich.name: Savannah Ostrich
savanah-ostrich.flavor: Head in the sand, answer in the air.

the-red-panda.name: The Red Panda
the-red-panda.flavor: Half bear, half raccoon, wholly adorable.

traveling-tortoise.name: Traveling Tortoise
traveling-tortoise.flavor: Halfway there, then half again. Still arrives.

trusty-horse.name: Trusty Horse
trusty-horse.flavor: Counts to ten by stamping. Never skips.

wandering-pinguin.name: Wandering Penguin
wandering-pinguin.flavor: Walks the meridian in a straight line.
